d:
Shri hanumanashtak aadity garhvi ke bhavyukt svar men. sankatmochan hanumanashtak ki sanrachna gosvami tulsidas ne ki thi. mana jata hai ki sankatmochan hanumanashtak ka path karne se vyakti apni har badha aur pira se mukt ho jata hai aur uske sabhi sankat dur ho jate hain.
Watch the video song of "Virah Ke Is Attal Sindhu Ne Ram Siya Ke Hridye " now!
Mata sit aur shri ram ek dusre se bichharne ke bad bahut dukhi rahne lage the aur jiske karan unka jivan duhkh ke badlo se ghira rahne laga tha.
"svar- ravindr jain aur kavita krishnamurthi
Git- ravindr jain
Sangit- ravindr jain"
